summary: Short arterial kerb beside a grass bank; no parking, customer car park behind.
reasons: Main road kerb, no parked cars
Grass bank, nowhere to pull off
Shop car park behind is customers only

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwelling is 27 m away; the neighbours are shops and a petrol-style forecourt car park, so seclusion would otherwise be fine.
drivers.access_and_room: A van would stop in the live lane of a multi-lane road; the verge is a steep grass bank with no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Heavy arterial traffic beside an overpass and signalised junction.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb; the mapped car parks nearby are for customers.

flags: Mapped car parks 4 and 9 m away are customers only
sun_shade: Open to sun; a building to the east shades the morning.
